description: Check whether an email address looks real and deliverable before sign-up, outreach or invoicing. For up to 25 addresses: RFC syntax, MX (or A fallback) records, disposable domain (CC0 list, ~10k domains), role account, free-mail provider, the domain's SPF and DMARC, and a verdict (valid, risky, invalid). It never contacts mail servers, so it cannot confirm that a mailbox exists. Use when you need a quick check with no side effects. $0.0015 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

email.description: Email address, or up to 25 comma-separated

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: email_verify
